catalogRegistration.role: coordinate-registration audit; photograph owns visible stars

cameraContract.qualification: Shared visual presentation derived from the accepted Mars contract; no per-object native camera or ephemeris parity is claimed.

pointSourcePresentation.positionSource: licensed ESO photographic local maxima; no Google catalogue bytes
pointSourcePresentation.qualification: native fixed-size catalogue behavior collapsed into the prepared cubemap; point positions and colors remain ESO-derived

sky.qualification: source-photographed full sky; orientation is registered to Galactic coordinates but no observer epoch or Sun ephemeris is claimed; no Sun is baked into the cubemap

controls.label: Photosphere
controls.description: Colorized HMI continuum mosaic for Carrington Rotation 2311, 12 May–9 June 2026. It combines different observation dates; limb normalization and polar continuation are prepared display adjustments.
controls.title: NASA SDO/HMI CR2311 central-meridian continuum mosaic with source-derived limb normalization and qualified polar continuation

controls.label: Magnetic field
controls.description: False-color HMI radial magnetic field for Carrington Rotation 2311, 12 May–9 June 2026. A synoptic mosaic, not a simultaneous photograph; weak and strong fields use a nonlinear color scale.
controls.title: False-colour NASA SDO/HMI CR2311 full-surface radial magnetic-field map

controls.label: Chromosphere
controls.description: False-color AIA 304 Å synoptic mosaic, 12 May–9 June 2026. Missing samples use latitude continuation. The stationary off-limb image is a separate observation from 27 May 2026.
controls.title: NASA SDO AIA 304 angstrom CR2311 full-surface synoptic map

controls.label: Corona
controls.description: False-color AIA 171 Å synoptic mosaic, 12 May–9 June 2026. Missing samples use latitude continuation. The stationary off-limb image is a separate observation from 27 May 2026.
controls.title: NASA SDO AIA 171 angstrom CR2311 full-surface synoptic map
